verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs cover the saved-plan artifact workflow: `tofu plan -out=FILE` writes a plan that is later executed by passing the file to `tofu apply`. Plan files can also be encrypted at rest, which suits CI artifact storage. However, the pack never mentions approval-skipping flags (e.g. auto-approve) or non-interactive/no-input operation, so the CI half of the story is undocumented here. Missing for 10: documented auto-approve/approval flags, non-interactive input-disabling options, CI-specific guidance or hands-on corroboration.
